column1: # Our own table, built by Skills/ghidra-ec/scripts/build_register_map.py from
# Chromium EC chip/it83xx/registers.h (BSD-style licence, The ChromiumOS Authors),
# revision 29862b38b164d9717d3ec31761364f2f70748629 (coreboot/chrome-ec main, last change to the file 2024-12-05).
# Family conditionals: the IT8320 side. INTC base 0x00F01100 from the chip config
# status: published = registers.h, confirmed for IT8227E; firmware = derived from the
# IT8227E firmware's code (it8227e-irq-overrides.tsv); unverified = an IT8320 name not checked
# for IT8227E (its description may still be a fact from the firmware: its source says so).
# `# replaced:` lines are published entries an overlay entry removed.

column3: SMBus channel D (IER0/ISR0 bit 4); the handler is a plain stub, the channel code enables IER0 bit 4
column4: IT8227E fw SmbChanRegsTable 0x239F8+3*0x2C: IER0 0xF01104, ISR0 0xF01100, mask 0x10
IT8227E fw SmbChanRegsTable 0x239F8+0*0x2C: IER1 0xF01105, ISR1 0xF01101, mask 2; IntcIrq009_MaskAck 0x5DBC
IT8227E fw SmbChanRegsTable 0x239F8+1*0x2C: IER1 0xF01105, ISR1 0xF01101, mask 4; IntcIrq010_MaskAck 0x5DDC
IT8227E fw SmbChanRegsTable 0x239F8+2*0x2C: IER2 0xF01106, ISR2 0xF01102, mask 1; IntcIrq016_MaskAck 0x5E2C

column3: PMC input buffer full; the handler serves PM1 and PM2 together (it also checks PM2STS 0xF01510 bit 1)
column4: IT8227E fw IsrIrqTable 0x5000+0x64 -> Isr_Irq025 0x5A38, PM2STS read at 0x5A3E

column3: in this firmware an empty stub: the handler only calls an empty function (0x5E74), nothing is masked, acknowledged or served; PM2 is served by IRQ 25
SMBus channel E (IER20/ISR20 bit 0); IT8320's IRQ 160 is PECI and its SMB_E is IRQ 152
column4: IT8227E fw SmbChanRegsTable 0x239F8+4*0x2C: IER20 0xF01155 (+0x1C), ISR20 0xF01154 (+0x20), mask 1 (+0x24); IsrIrqTable 0x5000+0x280 -> Isr_Irq160 0x53E8 -> IntcIrq160_MaskAck 0x608E
